title: One Fungus Is Still Reshaping Frog Survival Worldwide
hook: Extinction was only the first chapter of this amphibian disease.
closing: The damage spans extinction, continuing decline, and regional losses that recovery has not erased.
question: Which frog would you protect?

segments.say: The fungus affected 501 amphibian species. One pathogen created a worldwide survival crisis.
Thirty-nine percent of affected species are still declining. The crisis continued after scientists identified it.
The fungus hit 40 Australian frog species. The global crisis also reached isolated regional ecosystems.
